statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd'); case "$cwd" in "$HOME"*) dir="~${cwd#$HOME}";; *) dir="$cwd";; esac; br=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); printf '\033[1;36m%s\033[0m' "$dir"; [ -n "$br" ] && printf ' on \033[1;35m %s\033[0m' "$br"; exit 0
